system.name: OS-Harm
system.one_liner: Benchmark of 150 tasks measuring the safety of LLM computer-use agents in OSWorld across misuse, prompt injection and misbehaviour, graded by an LLM judge.

content.variant_note: four equal pale blue cards in a row: tasks, agent, traces, judge
content.argues: Safety of computer use agents can be measured by running tasks from three harm categories in OSWorld and having an LLM judge grade completion and safety from execution traces.
content.subject: Four cards: tasks in an Ubuntu VM, the LLM agent, its traces of screenshots and accessibility trees, an LLM judge.

lessons.what_to_learn: Give each stage of an evaluation pipeline one equal tinted card with a big title, one recognisable icon and a few short lines; reuse the same robot character for agent and judge (adding a robe and gavel) so roles read at a glance, and end the chain with the judge's questions as the output.
lessons.suits: Benchmark or evaluation-harness papers where tasks, a model under test, recorded traces and a grader form a short linear chain.

evidence: An LLM judge grades the successful completion of tasks and the safety of agent behavior according to a detailed prompt
First, we identify three main categories of risk: (1) deliberate user misuse
using execution traces that consist of agent reasoning steps, GUI screenshots, and summaries of accessibility trees.

summary: OS-Harm is a benchmark of 150 tasks, built on OSWorld, for measuring the safety of LLM computer-use agents across deliberate user misuse, prompt injection and model misbehaviour, with an LLM judge that grades task success and safety. Figure 1 is a left-to-right chain of four equal pale blue cards joined by thick arrows: OS-Harm tasks (apps Mail, Chrome and VS Code, categories C1 to C3, run in an Ubuntu VM), the LLM Agent (a blue robot, frontier LLMs plus OSWorld scaffolding, three vendor logos), Agent Traces (a mock screenshot and an accessibility tree) and the LLM Judge (the robot with a gavel asking Q1 and Q2).
summary_zh: OS-Harm 是衡量计算机使用智能体安全性的基准。图 1 用四张等大浅蓝卡片连成流程：任务（三类危害与应用图标）、LLM 智能体、执行轨迹（截图与无障碍树）、LLM 评审（戴法槌的机器人，问 Q1、Q2）。
notes: The pre-screen listed only stage-pipeline; scope-overview is added as a minor second kind for the harm categories and app icons in the first card. The four cards are counted as panels with axis stages; the figure can equally be read as one pipeline drawing with four stage boxes. The two trace tiles are drawn mocks, not real traces.
